content_blocks.label: message_1_David
content_blocks.text: Hey Karen, I’m facing some serious financial stress. My rent is due next month and I don’t have the money.

content_blocks.label: message_2_Karen
content_blocks.text: I’m sorry to hear that. Have you talked to your landlord yet?

content_blocks.label: message_3_David
content_blocks.text: Not yet, but I’m afraid they won’t be understanding. I’m thinking of asking for a deferment.

content_blocks.label: message_4_Karen
content_blocks.text: That’s a tough spot. I’ll try to help out if I can. Maybe we can find a solution together?
